name: Vashrin
note: An invented occupied city, rendered by the same engine as chicago.html and portland.html. Nothing here is surveyed: tools/make-vashrin.py generates vashrin-osm.json (terrain, river, streets, blocks, the ring wall) from a seed, and this file holds the districts, landmarks, viewpoints and the overcast sky. Positions are [lat, lon] against the fictional origin below; 1 degree of longitude here is 71,553 m, so the whole map is about 3.8 km across.
attribution: Vashrin is fiction: city, terrain and streets generated by tools/make-vashrin.py

districts._: [name, hex colour, base height, tallest, box as [lat south, lon west, lat north, lon east]]

el._: the transit line runs on a concrete viaduct straight through the city, east to west

landmarks.name: The Spire
landmarks.info: Assembly Plaza · nobody in the city remembers it being built. It stands on nothing that was here before, and everything in Vashrin is laid out to face it.

landmarks.name: Assembly Plaza
landmarks.info: A square of poured concrete, four hundred metres on a side, kept empty. The tram turns short of it and the streets stop at its edge.

landmarks.name: Central Transit
landmarks.info: The station under the viaduct. Departures are posted; arrivals are not.

landmarks.name: South-East Gate
landmarks.info: Where the ring road leaves the wall on the river side. Queues form before dawn.

landmarks.name: South Gate
landmarks.info: The road south, towards the flats and the old quarries.

landmarks.name: North-West Gate
landmarks.info: The freight gate: the spur from the yards runs out beside the road.

landmarks.name: North Gate
landmarks.info: The gate on the upper bank. From the watchtower here you can see the whole valley.

landmarks.name: Watchtower 4
landmarks.info: One of the masts on the wall. The light sweeps the ring road all night.

landmarks.name: Watchtower 9
landmarks.info: South wall. The lamp turns whether or not anyone is up there.

landmarks.name: Watchtower 16
landmarks.info: Above the river gate, looking down on the water.

landmarks.name: Plaza screen
landmarks.info: A blank grey panel four storeys up, lit from within after dark. It carries announcements. Today it carries nothing.

landmarks.name: Avenue screen
landmarks.info: The second of the plaza screens, facing the avenue.

landmarks.name: River Works
landmarks.info: The plant on the east bank. Its stacks are the only thing in the city that is reliably working.

landmarks.name: West Yards
landmarks.info: Sheds, cranes and a water tower, behind their own fence.

landmarks.name: Freight Yard
landmarks.info: Where the spur ends. Wagons are loaded at night.

landmarks.name: Old Park
landmarks.info: The last of the trees inside the wall, left because no one gave an order about them.

landmarks.name: The Vash
landmarks.info: The river the city was founded on, now walled with concrete for its whole length inside the ring.
